entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand. My order number is 881-5C4-239.

Certainly. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor delivered on December 17th. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no fault. I just need to return it. I had a medical emergency right after it arrived and I was in the hospital for weeks. I had to have surgery. I'm just getting my mail sorted now.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I certainly hope you're on the road to recovery. Let me just double-check the return eligibility here for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that the item was delivered 26 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. So that's no problem at all.
Good. So you can process the refund now?

Absolutely. I've just approved the return in the system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid shipping label. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any local post office.
And it's a full refund to my card?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you feel better soon.
